create_stageflow_subclass: create a StageFlow subclass to define ordered stages with initialized, started, completed, and failed statuses
get_stage_from_status: get the StageFlow stage member from a given status value using get_stage_from_status
get_next_runnable_stage: get the next runnable stage from a status using get_next_runnable_stage_from_status
check_status_type: check if a status is initialized, started, completed, or failed using is_initialized_status and similar methods
navigate_stages: navigate between stages using next_stage and previous_stage cached properties on a StageFlow member
